title: A strict minister father and a family that drifted apart
summary: Thompson describes his father's devotion to the ministry and regret at not keeping the family together; Thompson was the baby of the family.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: shortly after, about a year later. He was fortunate enough to find another very kind woman who became my mother, stepmother. And I actually didn't know the difference. And from this certificate also the facts show that there were six members of the family with me, and at my birth one of my sisters had died before I was born. So this made five of us in my family which included three other sisters and a brother. Very, very vague information I have on my family. My family was quite separated, you might say, to a certain degree, not only in mind, in spirit, but in association.

Because my father was a very strict minister who devoted perhaps all of his time to the ministry. And one of the most vivid statements that he made when he passed away, he died, last year, at the age of 97, was that he always regretted that he spent all of his life trying to teach other people and help them to purify their spiritual thoughts and prepare themselves for the hereafter, whatever that the ministry has to do with. And he always regretted that he wasn't able to keep his family more together as a family.

Because most of us finally drifted away because of the very, very rigid you might say curriculum of the church and you know, this strict order of regimentation. And I happened to be the baby of the family, the last to leave.
